The root cause is that `src/App.tsx` sent `flagsmith.trackEvent('Purchase')`, but the experiment's "Purchases" metric listens for the lowercase event `purchase`. Event names are case-sensitive, so the events arrived but were never counted as conversions.

The rest of the setup looks healthy. The warehouse is connected with 4,210 events received, and both variants show identities (171 control, 166 green). The only failure is the name mismatch, so I changed the call to `trackEvent('purchase')`.

I didn't run the app or re-check the experiment results. Conversions should start showing for purchases made after you deploy. Purchases tracked as `Purchase` before the fix won't be counted retroactively.
